card: This PR silences Tor control port connection warnings on nodes where Tor control has not been explicitly configured via -listenonion, -torcontrol, or -torpassword. For unconfigured nodes, connection failures are demoted to Tor debug logs and netbase connection refusal logging is disabled, eliminating roughly 18 lines of log noise per hour introduced in v32. When Tor control is explicitly configured, connection failures warn once before demoting to debug logging. It also adds an informational log when an active onion service connection drops.
changed_since_previous: ConnectDirectly now unconditionally sets manual_connection to false for Tor control connections, and explicitly configured connections use LogWarnThenDebug rather than unconditional warnings.
evidence: PR description: 'Before eae193e750... If tor wasn't running the refusal was reported later and only logged under -debug=tor. Since eae193e750 (in v32), every failed reconnect attempt logs... On a default configured node without tor, this pollutes debug.log with 18 lines every hour.'

Commit 4ec95781e0: 'The Tor control thread retries the connection indefinitely. Previously every failed attempt logged two warnings plus an info line from netbase, even for default nodes where the user never asked for Tor.'
problem: On nodes running default configurations without Tor installed or running, the node attempts to connect to the default Tor control port indefinitely, logging multiple warnings and netbase refusal notices every reconnect attempt (around 18 lines per hour in debug.log). In addition, when an active onion service unexpectedly drops, the node silently stops advertising it without logging an informational notice.

risk.why: A mistake could misconfigure or silence logs for Tor control connections or onion service registration.

summary: Suppresses Tor control port connection failure warnings unless Tor control is explicitly enabled via -listenonion, -torcontrol, or -torpassword. Unconfigured nodes route connection failures to the Tor debug log category and pass manual_connection=false to ConnectDirectly to silence netbase connection refusal logs. It also adds an informational log when an active onion service drops unexpectedly, and removes a redundant connection initiation warning.
